gloss: to get angry, to be irritated

definitions.gloss: to get angry, to be irritated, to be annoyed
definitions.explanation: Describes a feeling of anger or irritation rising within oneself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}られて→破る：02321_yaburu⟧{腹|はら}が{立|た}った。
examples.english: I got angry when they broke their promise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{腹|はら}が{立|た}つ。
examples.english: I'm frustrated with my own mistake.
Even when I'm angry, I don't show it on my face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧して⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧⟦{怒|おこ}られて→怒る：00876_okoru⟧、{腹|はら}が{立|た}って⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I hadn't done anything wrong, but I got scolded, and I couldn't help feeling furious.

notes:
STRUCTURE: ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧ (belly/stomach) + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + ⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand/rise). Literally 'one's belly rises' - the belly being associated with emotions in Japanese.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{怒|おこ}る→怒る：00876_okoru⟧ (to get angry) - more direct, general term
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ (to get angry) - colloquial, 'it comes to one's head'
- ⟦{腹立|はらだ}たしい→腹立たしい：21455_haradatashii⟧ (irritating) - adjective form
- ⟦{腹立|はらだ}ち→腹立ち：20111_haradachi⟧ (anger, irritation) - noun form

BODY PART METAPHOR: In Japanese, the ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧ (belly) is considered the seat of emotions, similar to how English uses 'heart.' This explains expressions like {腹|はら}が{立|た}つ and {腹|はら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{割|わ}って→割る：02334_waru⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ (to speak frankly).

GRAMMAR: Often used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ to indicate the cause of anger: 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{腹|はら}が{立|た}つ
